newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Urban gets SEC permit for securities.
newsitem.headline: Urban gets SEC permit for securities.

text.p: Urban Bank said on Monday the Securities and Exchange Commission recently approved the third tranche of its mortgage-backed securities worth 500 million pesos.
The bank said it is now the largest issuer of mortgage-backed securities totalling 1.5 billion pesos.

The mortgage-backed securities is a form of asset securitization whereby banks can raise funds by issuing certificates backed by loans, revolving lines of credits, and real estate mortgages. It helps develop a more efficient capital market, the bank said.
